!!! error TS2344: Type 'R' does not satisfy the constraint 'not { then(): any; }'.
!!! related TS2208 destructureOfVariableSameAsShorthand.ts:6:33: This type parameter might need an `extends not { then(): any; }` constraint.
    
    async function main() {
        // These work examples as expected
        get().then((response) => {
            // body is never
            const body = response.data;
        })
        get().then(({ data }) => {
            // data is never
        })
        const response = await get()
        // body is never
        const body = response.data;
        // data is never
        const { data } = await get<never>();
    
        // The following did not work as expected.
        // shouldBeNever should be never, but was any
